incidents.name: GoodCompound
incidents.notes: GoodDollar collectInterest double-counted duplicated staking-contract entries to over-claim COMP

sources.ref: delegatecall-target review (callTracer + prestateTracer on the exploit tx, then eth_getStorageAt over [creation block, incident block]): the victim is a Compound Unitroller and the exploit tx DELEGATECALLs from 0x3d9819210a31b4961b30ef54be2aed79b9c9cd3b to 0xbafe01ff935c7305907c33bf824352ee5979b526 for every selector, an address held in storage slot 2 (comptrollerImplementation), not in the EIP-1967 slot - which is why no Upgraded event exists and the row previously measured from the 2019 deployment. Binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 2 between the creation block 7710671 and the incident block 18759541 recovers 13 implementation swaps: 0x62f18c45 (2019-05-07, block 7710677), 0x178053c0 (2019-05-08), 0xf592ef67 (2019-10-23), 0x97bd4cc8 (2020-03-16), 0x9d0a0443 (2020-06-15), 0xaf601cbf (2020-07-02), 0x7b5e3521 (2020-09-13), 0x7d47d3f0 (2020-12-10), 0xbe7616b0 (2020-12-26), 0x75442ac7 (2021-07-06), 0x374abb8c (2021-09-29), 0x234b619b (2021-10-09) and finally 0xbafe01ff935c7305907c33bf824352ee5979b526 at block 13449598, 2021-10-19T17:50:24Z; 60 evenly spaced samples between that block and the incident all return 0xbafe01ff, so the executing code was 782.3 days old rather than the 1679 days measured from deployment
not a duplicate of the 2021 Compound row: same Unitroller, but its implementation was swapped 13 times in between and last changed 2021-10-19, so this 2023 incident hit different executing code

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2021-10-19T17:50:24Z (block 13449598): Unitroller comptrollerImplementation, storage slot 2, last written to 0xbafe01ff935c7305907c33bf824352ee5979b526 before the incident
